response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_inst FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_inst) AS baseline FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_inst) AS mean_of_above_avgs, AVG(g.avg_inst - b.baseline) AS mean_excess FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.avg_inst > b.baseline

assumptions.assumption: Groups whose instownpct is entirely NULL have a NULL average; AVG over group averages skips them, so they count neither in the baseline nor among the above-baseline groups.
If no group exceeds the baseline (e.g. all averages equal), the query returns one row with NULLs.
